contexts.text: Visions which are illusions. Described. SE 1752. SE 1755.
Let them beware when they come into the other life lest they be illuded; for evil spirits know how to present various illusions before those who are fresh from the world...
The idea is like an image which illudes...
They said that they were illusions... They supposed it was an illusion...
Perhaps these were the illusions of Spirits concerning things to come.
Such a phantasy may be called an illusive phantasy...
Such are the illusions of these Spirits...
The man then supposes that it is... either an illusion or a vision.
